_comment: MSTR capital structure: claims that rank ahead of common stock. Consumed by
pricemodel/valuation.py (net NAV, net mNAV, structural leverage), which the
web app and the mstr-valuation skill both build on. The daily report in
pricemodel/cli.py does not read this file - its mNAV is gross by design.
IMPORTANT: every figure below is an UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER, shaped to be
structurally realistic so the app runs out of the box, and not sourced from
any filing. Replace these from the most recent 10-Q and set 'verified': true
before quoting any net-NAV number. Until then every surface says UNVERIFIED.
Convertible notes: 'face_usd' is principal outstanding, 'conversion_price' is
the price per share at which the note converts. Shares are derived as
face_usd / conversion_price unless 'shares_if_converted' is given. A note is
treated as equity when MSTR trades at or above its conversion price and as
debt otherwise - never as both, which would charge for it twice.
Preferred: 'liquidation_preference_usd' is the total claim ranking ahead of
common. 'annual_dividend_usd' is not subtracted from NAV (it is a flow, not a
claim on assets) but is reported as a recurring drain on the treasury.
